title: Account Custom Instruction Wrapper — Alias Lookup
applicability: This reference defines a lossless, case-sensitive mapping of JSON object-member keys in the editable aliased copy of the account custom-instruction wrapper. It is not a substitute for the separately referenced structural rules or machine-dialect writing rules.

mapping_semantics.keys: Each distinct object-member key appearing anywhere in the source JSON has exactly one alias, including member keys in nested objects and objects inside arrays. The same original name is always encoded by the same alias.
mapping_semantics.first_character: The first character of every alias must equal the exact first character of its original key, preserving capitalization.
mapping_semantics.allocation: Preserve previously assigned aliases for every key retained in the current draft. For a newly introduced key, assign its exact first character if available; otherwise use the shortest free two-character alias beginning with that character and a suffix from a-z, A-Z, or 0-9. Reuse the same alias for every occurrence of one original key.
mapping_semantics.data_preservation: Replace JSON object-member keys only. Preserve all array positions, strings, numbers, booleans, nulls, object relationships, and rule bodies without modification.
mapping_semantics.additional_lookup_member: In the aliased copy, the outer index-zero explainer exposes the literal alias_lookup_path and reference_base_url members without aliasing. These bootstrap values let an agent locate the GitHub repository and fetch the alias dictionary before interpreting any encoded key names. All other names use their allocated aliases.
mapping_semantics.decoding: Read reference_base_url and alias_lookup_path from the outer index-zero explainer, fetch the lookup file by resolving alias_lookup_path against reference_base_url, and decode all other object-member aliases recursively using alias_to_key. Preserve the literal reference_base_url and remove the alias_lookup_path bootstrap-only member to reconstruct the unaliased draft.
